walkthroughs.body_html:
Theme 1: Evolution of French Society — a core area of A-Level French.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Theme 1: Evolution of French Society brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Theme 1: Evolution of French Society.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: When does the past participle agree with avoir verbs?
options: Always.
All letters are pronounced equally.
Never - avoir never causes agreement.
When the direct object comes BEFORE the verb (la pomme que j'ai mangée).

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I do not eat' in French?
options: Je mange ne pas.
All letters are pronounced equally.
Je ne mange pas.
Je ne pas mange.

mcqs.q: Which letter is typically SILENT at the end of French words like 'petit' or 'froid'?
options: Je mange ne pas.
The vowels.
All letters are pronounced equally.
Final consonants (the -t, -d).
